text:
alyssa: Quick Q — I moved from full-time to 0.6 FTE on Feb 18. How does PTO carryover work for this calendar year? My manager flagged the year-end blackout window too. TL;DR: can I keep hours I accrued as FT or is it prorated?

jamie: Hi! Good Q. Accruals are pro-rated by FTE for the period you're on each status. So PTO earned before Feb 18 as FT stays. After switch accrues at 0.6 rate. Carryover cap applies to your *balance* at year-end.

mario: To add: we run the year-end snapshot on Dec 31 11:59pm PT (payroll cutoff). If you have pending manager approvals after that the hours won't count until next year.

tess (People Ops): Official: Carryover cap = 40 hours (2 weeks) for exempt salaried employees, unless an approved exception. Part-time pro-rates the cap by FTE: `cap_prorated = round(40 * FTE, 1)` Example: 0.6 FTE => 24 hrs carryover.

alyssa: So I should expect ~24 hrs max. What about the blackout window (Dec 24–Jan 2)? If I'm on PTO during blackout and can't submit timesheets, any help?

tess (People Ops): Blackout != automatic forfeiture. If you cannot submit before payroll cutoff due to timezone/holiday, file the "year-end carryover exception" form. Manager signoff required. We also accept support tickets via hr-bot.

hr-bot: Form: https://redwood.okta/forms/yr-end-carryover | Deadline to request exception: Jan 10 11:59pm PT. Payroll note: approvals after Jan 2 may take one payroll cycle to process.

jamie: FYI managers should use the "Carryover approval" action in BambooHR (People > Time Off > Requests). Quick steps:
1) Open employee record
2) Select 'Year-end exception'
3) Add approval note + attach supporting convo

mario: Two recs: 1) Ask managers to pre-approve expected carryover by Dec 15 if possible. 2) People Ops will run a sanity check and reach out to managers with >50 employees with exceptions (:eyes:).

alyssa: Thanks all — filing the form now. cc @maria (eng manager) to confirm approval.

maria (Eng Manager): Approved, leaving note in BambooHR. :thumbsup: 

tess (People Ops): Got it, Alyssa — we logged this. If anything changes ping me.
